title: Navimower 0.4.3-beta42

- Adds cached MQTT navigation diagnostics for controlled gate-transition testing without changing `gate_required` behavior.
- Diagnostics now expose MQTT action/sub-action, packed work action/sub-action/mode/target/progress, live mow boundary, partition ids, task delay, physical zone, target source, gate states and arrival guards.
- Includes MQTT topic/key inventory and the existing sanitized passive-discovery output in downloaded diagnostics so raw `/realtimeDate/location` and `/realtimeDate/event` samples can be correlated when Passive MQTT discovery is temporarily enabled.
- Keeps diagnostics cached-only: downloading diagnostics does not make additional vendor requests.
